experiment: AntMaze V6 mainline with learned-ETT futures (arm ETT) vs the sealed simulator futures (CF) and the recorded futures (O); five paired seeds
status: oracle-supervised engineering stage (the ETT was supervised by the simulator); the training futures of arm ETT are the model's

ett.motion: the SIMULATOR with both rockfalls forced inactive (physics only; an oracle diagnostic control, not a learned method)
ett.rollout_check: ett_rollout_v3/hist_exact (variant B: pooled death 0.312 vs sim 0.294, KS death time 0.028)
ett.cross_fitting: anchor k uses the models of its source-episode fold (supervision.npz fold_anchor)

generation.construction: the logged torque once from the logged row, then the start agent mode (exp_v6_mainline_pilot.mode_policy) closed-loop through the model; one realised path per anchor; onset sampled per step; ends on reach / death / horizon 800 - t; no goal hold
generation.query_coverage: logged torque only (as the sealed CF table)

arms.CF: critic futures = the sealed simulator branches (branches_cf.npz)

evaluation.targets: ETT / CF / O seeds 0-4 and the start agent on the same 300 episodes

judgement.primary: ETT - O success on the common episodes, per paired seed: mean > 2 x seed s.e. and 5 / 5
judgement.oracle_reference: CF - O under the same rule at five seeds (the oracle gain re-established)
judgement.retention: (ETT - O) / (CF - O) reported; ETT - CF reported (how much of the oracle gain the learned futures keep)
judgement.generation_check: branches_ett outcome shares vs the sealed simulator table, pooled and by anchor region (reported; a pooled death-share gap > 0.05 flags the futures)
judgement.no_selection: every final evaluated once; no tuning after the result
